notes.subject: יסכן
notes.rationale: 'be profitable/useful' vs 'be familiar/minister to'; KJV takes it as profit, some take as intimate service

notes.subject: עלימו
notes.rationale: 'upon him' i.e. to God (KJV reads 'to himself' repointing עלימו as עָלָיו); Hebrew as written says 'upon Him'

notes.subject: El
notes.rationale: הלאל is 'the El' (God), not just 'God' as a common noun; the name-shape kept

translation: Yala gbɛrɛ bɛ se ka kɛ nafa ye El ye, wa ni mɔgɔ don-dɔnnin bɛ nafa sɔrɔ ⟨a yɛrɛ la⟩?

tokens.gloss: bɛ se ka kɛ nafa ye
